task: BASS_HE E13C3 independent Decimal first coefficient-variation numerical contribution
objective: Compute the new local first variation using independently implemented damped response and moment kernels, and compare with the SAVED E13C2 continuous-minus-frozen Decimal reference.
original_motivation: Test whether photon coefficient-variation error on captured fixed gas paths admits a cheap signed correction while preserving photon number and energy ownership.

in: Six previously selected local captured segments only; each correction has e_a=0 and each frozen field starts at captured f0.
70-digit Decimal quadrature at degrees 12 and 20 for the NEW first coefficient variation.
Signed endpoint, absorber number, absorber energy, primary heat, redshift energy, and source differences.
Input identity, new code as-run identity, raw logs, actual command, runtime versions and actual exit.
out: Rerunning E13C2 continuous ODE/collocation or any old oracle main.
Gas, Newton, native, coupled, campaign or globally carried photon execution.
Atomic RCT emission, owner adoption, production admission, interval enclosure or global error bound.

mathematical_contract.sources: delta_QN=integral delta_q dv; delta_QE=integral E*delta_q dv
mathematical_contract.full_equation_remainder: The first-variation equation omits -delta_Lambda*e1; finite first-variation ledgers do not eliminate this second-order remainder.

numerics.input_lift: CSV text -> Python binary64 -> Decimal.from_float exactly, matching E13C2
numerics.positivity_claim_limit: Sampled values only; no minimum enclosure or global positivity proof.

predeclared_gates.input_identity: All pins, exact saved six keys, original captured CSV/stage hashes and embedded-row equality must pass.
predeclared_gates.finite: All calculated Decimal numerical outputs must be finite.
predeclared_gates.zero_rate_J_limit: J(0,t)=t exactly at t in {0,1e-7,1}; zero duration gives zero for nonzero rates.

heat_defect_accuracy_research_diagnostic.below_floor_policy: Relative status UNRESOLVED_BELOW_ABSOLUTE_FLOOR; separately report absolute error<=floor and error/max(abs(reference),floor).
heat_defect_accuracy_research_diagnostic.scope: Local total signed heat DEFECT; not total baseline heat, not the complete E13C2 data set.

independence.reused_unchanged: E13C2 Decimal Coefficients physical definitions and Gauss-Legendre rule helper, including their dependencies.
independence.newly_implemented: Exact captured frozen field, J response kernel, first-variation endpoint and one-dimensional Fubini moments, heat/ledger/error calculations.
independence.comparison: Parent will independently implement a longdouble GL8/12 formula. This contributor shares physical definitions with the saved E13C2 reference and does not claim independence of the atomic/source model.

failure_policy: Preserve first failed execution and diagnose it. No post hoc threshold relaxation. Numerical-gate failure is separate from research approximation-diagnostic failure.
completion_bar: Six completed local calculations with two new quadrature degrees, saved-reference defect comparisons, first-variation ledgers, disclosed shared definitions, and execution provenance. Final acceptance belongs to a separate decision reviewer.
